---
title: "NDVI Nomalizing Code"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}

read_rds("./raw_extracts/extracted_ndvi_value.rds") -> extracts

```

```{r}

bind_rows(read_csv("./metadata/pss4_metadata_Denver_sensitivity_2018_2024(in).csv"),
          read_csv("./metadata/pss4_metadata_Denver_2024_2025(in).csv") ) %>% 
  mutate(  date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
    time = stringr::str_pad(as.character(time), 6, pad = "0"),
         date = as_date(date),
    im_date_time = as.POSIXct(paste(date, time),
                             format="%Y-%m-%d %H%M%S",
                             tz = "UTC")) %>% 
  select(im_date_time, pss4_instrument) -> meta_data

extracts %>% 
  left_join(meta_data, by = "im_date_time") %>% 
  mutate(
    instrument_clean = fix_hex_id(pss4_instrument),
    sensor_gen = case_when(
      grepl("^0[ef][0-9a-f]{2}$|^10[0-9a-f]{2}$", instrument_clean) ~ "PS2.SD",
      grepl("^2[2345]",                             instrument_clean) ~ "PSB.SD",
      TRUE ~ "PS2.SD"
    ),
    doy = yday(im_date),
    month = month(im_date, label = TRUE)   
  ) -> extracts_sensor_gen -> extracts_sensor_gen

```

```{r}

set.seed(42)

extracts_sensor_gen %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 50000) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = doy, y = ndvi)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sensor_gen), alpha = 0.02, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = sensor_gen, group = sensor_gen),
              method = "loess", span = 0.3,
              se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(color = "black", linetype = "dashed",  # <- overall trend
              method = "loess", span = 0.3,
              se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("PS2.SD" = "#1f78b4", "PSB.SD" = "#33a02c")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 91, 182, 274, 365),
                     labels = c("Jan", "Apr", "Jul", "Oct", "Dec")) +
  labs(
    title   = "NDVI Seasonal Curve by Sensor Generation",
    x       = NULL,
    y       = "NDVI",
    color   = "Sensor",
    caption = "Dashed line = overall trend"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

extracts_sensor_gen %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 50000) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = sensor_gen, y = ndvi, fill = sensor_gen)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.1, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("PS2.SD" = "#1f78b4", "PSB.SD" = "#33a02c")) +
  labs(
    title = "NDVI Distribution by Sensor Generation",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "NDVI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

extracts_sensor_gen %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 50000) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = ndvi, fill = sensor_gen)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.05, outlier.size = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("PS2.SD" = "#1f78b4", "PSB.SD" = "#33a02c")) +
  labs(
    title = "NDVI by Month and Sensor Generation",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "NDVI",
    fill  = "Sensor"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

extracts_sensor_gen %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 50000) %>% 
  mutate(year = factor(year(im_date))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = ndvi, fill = sensor_gen)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.05, outlier.size = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("PS2.SD" = "#1f78b4", "PSB.SD" = "#33a02c")) +
  labs(
    title = "NDVI by Year and Sensor Generation",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "NDVI",
    fill  = "Sensor"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
